title: Want Your AI to Code Like Google Engineers? Start With These 24 Free Skills.
description:
Your AI codes like a confident intern: fast, sure of itself, and broken the week real users arrive. One of Google's best known engineering leads just released the fix.

Agent Skills is a pack of 24 skills by Addy Osmani, the engineering lead who runs Chrome's developer experience at Google. Over 80,000 stars on GitHub and climbing, one of the fastest growing repos of 2026. The skills cover planning, coding, testing and publishing, and your agent activates the right one at the right stage on its own. You explain the idea, it builds a full plan with tasks and checkpoints, follows Google style practices while it codes, tests its own work, and runs a senior level review plus a pre launch checklist before anything ships.

Will bugs become impossible? No. But your agent stops guessing like an intern and starts following process like a senior. One line installs it into over 70 agents, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and Cline.
